# clicmdv1

```go
import clicmdv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/cli/commands/v1"
```

Package clicmdv1 is the cli.commands/v1 contract: the \`pocketone\` command tree. Each command path ("remote restore to") has at most one provider. Every operation of every wire contract linked into the binary is a command by default, under \`remote\` ([Generated](#generated)); an extension replaces one by providing the same path, or adds its own:

	clicmdv1.Contract.Provide(app, clicmdv1.Command{Path: "remote rehash", Short: "...", Run: ...})

[Mount](#mount) builds the tree once the app's contracts are sealed. Two extensions providing one path are a startup error until pocketone.yaml picks one (\`providers: {cli.commands/v1: {"remote rehash": rehasher}}\`).

Source: [`ext/contracts/cli/commands/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/cli/commands/v1).

## Variables

<a id="contract"></a>

```go
var Contract = extkit.NewKeyedContract[Command]("cli.commands/v1", func(c Command) string { return c.Path })
```

Contract is cli.commands/v1, keyed by command path.

## Functions

### Mount

```go
func Mount(app core.App, root *cobra.Command)
```

Mount adds app's commands to root: every provided cli.commands/v1 command (replacing a command already at its path), then the generated ones nothing provides and root doesn't already have. Call it once app's contracts are sealed (after the standard set's Register, or extkit.Setup).

### PathOf

```go
func PathOf(id extkit.ContractID, op string) string
```

PathOf is the command path of a contract operation: \`remote\`, the contract id's words (without a leading "remote"), then the operation, with the last id word dropped from its front: restore/v1's restore\_to is "remote restore to", remote/v1's status is "remote status", mail.suppression/v1's check is "remote mail suppression check".

## Types

### Command

```go
type Command struct {
	Path  string // the words after the binary's name: "remote restore to"
	Use   string // its arguments as help shows them ("<name> <url>"); "" for none
	Short string
	Long  string
	Args  cobra.PositionalArgs // nil: any
	Flags func(fs *pflag.FlagSet)
	Run   func(c *Ctx, args []string) error
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Command is one \`pocketone\` command.

### Generated

```go
func Generated() []Command
```

Generated is a command for every operation people call of every wire contract linked into the binary: flags from its input's fields (and --json for the whole input), the answer printed as JSON. Public operations that take or return a raw body (an unsubscribe page, a mail provider's webhook) are for browsers and services, not people, and get none.

### CommandRef

```go
type CommandRef struct {
	Path     string    `json:"path"` // the words after the binary's name: "remote restore to"
	Use      string    `json:"use"`  // the arguments as help shows them
	Short    string    `json:"short,omitempty"`
	Long     string    `json:"long,omitempty"`
	Aliases  []string  `json:"aliases,omitempty"`
	Flags    []FlagRef `json:"flags,omitempty"`
	Runnable bool      `json:"runnable"` // false: a group of subcommands
	// Source says who answers it: "pocketbase" (PocketBase's own commands), "ext/<name>" (an extension),
	// "contract:<id>" (generated from a contract's operation), "contracts/<id>" (a contract package's shared client),
	// "main" (the binary itself); "" when it can't be told (a group).
	Source string `json:"source,omitempty"`
}
```

CommandRef is one command, every subcommand listed by its full path.

### ContractRef

```go
type ContractRef struct {
	ID       string  `json:"id"`
	Prefix   string  `json:"prefix"` // /api/_c/<id>
	Routed   bool    `json:"routed"` // its own API shape: no generated operations
	Provider string  `json:"provider,omitempty"`
	Provided bool    `json:"provided"`
	Ops      []OpRef `json:"ops,omitempty"`
}
```

ContractRef is a contract with an HTTP API.

### Ctx

```go
type Ctx struct {
	context.Context
	Cmd *cobra.Command
	Out io.Writer
}
```

Ctx is a running command.

### Ctx.Caller

```go
func (c *Ctx) Caller(id extkit.ContractID) (*extkit.Caller, error)
```

Caller calls contract id on the command's remote.

### Ctx.Flags

```go
func (c *Ctx) Flags() *pflag.FlagSet
```

Flags are the command's flags.

### Ctx.Remote

```go
func (c *Ctx) Remote() (*remoteclient.Client, error)
```

Remote opens the remote the command talks to: --remote (a name or URL), else the project's default remote, with its saved login (or the CI token). With no login it still returns the client, unauthenticated, so public operations work and the rest fail with the remote's own "sign in first".

### FieldRef

```go
type FieldRef struct {
	Name string `json:"name"` // in the JSON body / MCP arguments
	Flag string `json:"flag"` // the command's flag, without "--"
	Type string `json:"type"` // string, bool, int, float, time, strings, json
}
```

FieldRef is one field of an operation's input.

### FlagRef

```go
type FlagRef struct {
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Shorthand string `json:"shorthand,omitempty"`
	Type      string `json:"type"`
	Default   string `json:"default,omitempty"`
	Usage     string `json:"usage,omitempty"`
}
```

FlagRef is one flag.

### JSRef

```go
type JSRef struct {
	Extension string `json:"extension"`
	Types     string `json:"types"`
}
```

JSRef is what one extension adds to an app's JS API (pb\_hooks and page code): its TypeScript declarations, as they go into the app's types.d.ts. Extension "contracts" is extkit's: the contracts' action hooks and types open to JS.

### OpRef

```go
type OpRef struct {
	Name     string     `json:"name"`
	Desc     string     `json:"desc,omitempty"`
	Method   string     `json:"method"`
	REST     string     `json:"rest"` // METHOD's path: /api/_c/<id>/<path>
	Scope    string     `json:"scope"`
	Out      string     `json:"out"` // json, stream or raw
	RawIn    bool       `json:"rawIn,omitempty"`
	Command  string     `json:"command,omitempty"` // the pocketone command; "" for raw public operations
	Tool     string     `json:"tool,omitempty"`    // the MCP tool; "" for uploads and downloads
	ReadOnly bool       `json:"readOnly"`
	Input    []FieldRef `json:"input,omitempty"`
}
```

OpRef is one operation and the ways to call it.

### Reference

```go
type Reference struct {
	Global    []FlagRef     `json:"global"` // the root's persistent flags, which every command takes
	Commands  []CommandRef  `json:"commands"`
	Contracts []ContractRef `json:"contracts"`
	JS        []JSRef       `json:"js,omitempty"`
}
```

Reference is the binary's command tree and the HTTP APIs and MCP tools of every contract linked into it, as \`pocketone reference --json\` prints it. pocketone.dev's CLI, REST and MCP references and each contract's and extension's "Commands and APIs" section are generated from it (site/sync).

### BuildReference

```go
func BuildReference(app core.App, root *cobra.Command) Reference
```

BuildReference describes root's command tree and the contract APIs linked into the binary, with their providers on app.
